# Trail Peak Design System

> CSS-only, no-build design system: warm earthen palette, offset (no-blur) shadows, 1px bark borders, Playfair/Inter/Fira Code/Pirata One. All tokens live in colors_and_type.css.

## Start here
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): token structure, design constraints, contrast pairing rules, CI
- [colors_and_type.css](colors_and_type.css): source of truth for every token (light :root, dark .dark)
- [components.css](components.css): .tp-btn, .tp-card, .tp-input, .tp-field, .tp-check, page shell classes; the source of truth for component styles
- [components.json](components.json): component classes, variants, states and tokens, generated from components.css
- [tokens.json](tokens.json): same tokens as JSON, generated by scripts/build-tokens-json.mjs
- [README.md](README.md): brand voice, visual foundations, iconography

## Reference
- Component classes and usage markup: see "Components" in [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)
- [PREVIEWS.md](PREVIEWS.md): index of component and token specimens in preview/
- [shadcn/README.md](shadcn/README.md): mapping to the shadcn/ui Tailwind v4 theme
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to change the system, breaking-change rule

## Rules agents most often break
- Use var(--token); never hardcode hex or rgb().
- Shadows are offset-only: X Y 0 0 color.
- Icons are Phosphor via CDN; no inline SVG.
- Text on --bg-3 uses --fg-secondary, not --fg-muted. Body-size accent text uses --accent-strong, not --accent.
